utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — let’s start with the corner by the community garden and work our way down the block.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late, but I’m here—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what’s the easiest way for me to pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Could you start by reaching out to a few neighbors and see who’s interested? Once you’ve got a list, I can help organize the next steps.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that repair drive’s still rolling — folks are collecting donations and sorting out the biggest fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me—let’s set a clear time for the repair drive and keep to it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Faye, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, we’re still on for it this weekend. I just need the timing so I can work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’ll be there to help out and keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll bring it up at the repair drive and let everyone know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, that sounds good—just give me the time and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great—how about Saturday at 10 a.m.? I’ll send the details along so it’s easy to join.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Uli — I’ll keep it low-key and share only what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Hana — I’ll follow up with the details and keep it simple. Gus said he can help with tools if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of the repair drive locations. Where should we start?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard folks are still gathering donations and making a list of what needs fixing first. Maybe we should start with the busiest spots and go from there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mara — could you start by sorting the donated tools and checking what’s missing? That’d help us a lot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with that, but I’d rather keep it quiet and stay out of the spotlight.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what we’ve got left for the repair drive and make a quick list. Tell me what’s most needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Cleo—once you’ve got the list, send it my way and I’ll round up whatever tools are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m here now—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, it’s still happening.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good to hear — I’m just trying to avoid school-hour traffic. Can we aim for an after-school window?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
